visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black tank top and dark trousers stands still in the distance within a sprawling green field. The camera is positioned extremely low, almost touching the soil, causing the lush green grass blades to dominate the foreground. The sky is filled with heavy, grey, textured clouds suggesting a storm or overcast day. (2) The camera glides forward through the thick vegetation, revealing a Corgi with brown and white fur. The dog is seen sniffing the grass intently as it moves closer to the lens. The man in the background remains stationary, observing the pet's behavior in the open outdoor space. (3) The camera rises vertically into a bird's-eye view, capturing the expansive nature of the green lawn. The Corgi appears as a small, isolated figure in the middle of the grass. The man at the bottom of the frame is seen looking directly upwards, seemingly controlling the camera's movement. Dense trees frame the perimeter.
